content_blocks.label: clause_1._Parties
content_blocks.text: This complaint is brought by Tech Innovate Inc., hereinafter referred to as 'the Plaintiff', against Digital Solutions Corp., hereinafter referred to as 'the Defendant'.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Factual_Background
content_blocks.text: On or about June 15, 2024, the Defendant entered into a contract with the Plaintiff for the provision of software development services, as detailed in Exhibit B attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Claims_for_Relief
content_blocks.text: The Plaintiff hereby demands judgment against the Defendant for breach of contract and seeks damages in the amount of $100,000.
